notes.title: Devlog: #3 Демо доступно
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, Dwarves.[/h1][p]
Finally moderation, Steam approved the demo, so let’s go savor this triple crap.
We’re waiting for your feedback on Steam, it’s very important, and it doesn’t matter what it will be.

[/p][h1]What We’re Working On Now[/h1][p]We’re optimizing this disgrace, on older graphics cards it still looks like a complete mess, but it needs to be finished:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/b8ba80f12dcf466552348de22382b2297238174a.jpg"][/img]We’re reworking the bots, during demo testing, many people complained, that the bots behave like in a typical indie shooter crap, we’re working on improvements:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/8572d522533583c0a06912a00ed8e0c952478aa1.jpg"][/img]We’re tinkering with the levels, in this demo version, only 1 level will be available, we’ll be polishing it, now we’re implementing a portal system, to reduce the load on the video card:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/71eb1bfb98e6b9196fc40aad0bf424258f44c3cd.jpg"][/img]We’re improving the graphics, refining the game’s style ala Cain Lich 2, Days Gone, our art director is working hard for you:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/cd882a38fb2dbe3ddbb4a91b9cdc63207e8fc1e8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/2f30aa6c67bbb270fed6e5cb9d01cb2d62181550.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/ed3d8d839646707297881ce460dabe049f31d196.jpg"][/img]Other levels, story cutscenes, etc. will be available after the game’s release in summer, and to beta testers.

[/p][h1]For Inquiries, Please Contact:[/h1][list][*][p] For collaboration inquiries (media, social networks, etc.): press@toxicdev.ru

— Toxic Developer[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2: Preparing for the Demo Release
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Dwarves.[/h1]

Today we’ve sent the demo off for Steam review, who knows if we’ll make it into the game festival and rack up wishlists, we’ll see, but for now catch a batch of new screenshots from the demo:

[i]Shooting in that very mobster’s sauna[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/70d4ee4c5d54c1afe5745d32d40b16ed8358cad3.jpg[/img]
[i]Only she will survive, you can spare her if you want, after all she collected all the silver spoons[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/0ea3cb0735b799eacb8b20fbc807215251649650.jpg[/img]
[i]Denchik emerges from the mobster’s building[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/225971ac1bc60738c357174f4d9b07543bd9f362.jpg[/img]
[i]Shootouts, because what’s a game without them...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/4904265c7771b633a8af15e90fa32634de445288.jpg[/img]
[i]You look so cool against the helicopter backdrop—then again maybe it’s all fiction and he’s actually asleep?...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/4b7b732e52eaa8081cb773991d81c2e64a321c07.jpg[/img]

[h1]Aside from the Demo Release[/h1]
We’ve been grinding for a long time and have improved the game engine [b]Nuclear Engine[/b] in every possible way:

+Added dynamic destructibility of objects—when you get out of the mobster’s basements and catacombs, try blowing up his house
+Added dismemberment for enemies, which works with any type of foes
+Adding your own weapons in two clicks
+Adding factions to bots in two clicks
+Adding destructibility to objects
+Adding bot spawners to create unexpected situations

We also added a ton of new content:
+Added new weapon LR-300
+Added mercy mechanic
+Added head-bobbing a la SAMP RP
+Added hostile factions for bots
+Added active ragdoll animations for bots
+Added head popping
+Added dynamic blood and damage indicator
+Reworked the Mojo mechanic, which will block damage if you play well
+Those very spoons

The release is close.
Very.

[b]Dwarves, prepare your wallets.[/b]

— Toxic Developer

notes.title: Devlog #1: Начало Конца
notes.content:
[h1]What's up, midgets.[/h1]

While you're out there munching on slavs, we're busting our asses here: gameplay is almost done, now we're knee-deep in building the levels.
Yeah-yeah, first maps are on the way, and soon enough you’ll get to touch a demo. Just one location for now.

[i]Alright, let’s break it down.[/i]

[h2]#1 GunS Galore[/h2]
We’ve added a damn arsenal.
— From legendary, dangerously sharp knives,
— To whisper-quiet SMGs that’ll make enemies melt into meat confetti.
— Every weapon has its own vibe: damage, fire rate, mag size — enough for everyone to find their favorite tool of chaos.

+knife
+beretta
+deagle
+glock
+mac10
+makarov
+uzi
+akm
+k2
+m16
+protecc
+toz
+usas12

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/c5d988902c6eb11901be254d28f52ff7cd8f2206.jpg[/img]
d̶i̶s̶m̶e̶m̶b̶e̶r̶m̶e̶n̶t̶’̶s̶ ̶c̶o̶m̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶t̶o̶o̶

[h2]#2 Graphics so juicy you’ll want to bathe in them[/h2]
Shaders have been rewritten:

— Hair now splits into strands and shines almost like real life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/4628a01d5167888a2a28d9754082868a9176c08d.jpg[/img]
— The “filmed-on-a-potato” cam effect got a massive glow-up: added bloom, low bitrate, shaky cam, light flares, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/09eb3ca2337b3e30caf3b3b65442eb6e384afb02.png[/img]

All for the vibe. You're welcome.

[h2]#3 AAAAA Maps[/h2]
We’re grinding on the levels. Shapes are forming, stuff's starting to look like something. Here's a peek:

— Sauna with a pool and disco lighting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/8e0313da391646ebdca58595a67e93ce7e0918d1.jpg[/img]

— Mafia boss mansion — yeah, that guy’s place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/831a134f124c416ead9ca11e2d1f3eda78057178.png[/img]

— Wine cellar... okay, it’s just a cellar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/a51dd67e19703279f9063bf6928a2ba9586f99de.png[/img]

— Denchik’s already on his way to fix this mess.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/0c73cde4d2da29021a441e9be2499ee27b77d313.jpg[/img]

— Speaking of Denchik — he’s got a new crib now. Looks like shit, feels like home.
Stuffed with easter eggs. Tradition must be respected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/cc5063057a5177316942deba86b4bd9f5f6fd4db.png[/img]

[h2]#5 Enemies Gained a Brain[/h2]
— They can fight Den in melee, mid, and ranged.
— Get scared when you point a gun at them.
— Try to dodge bullets like they value life or something.
— Pick up weapons left lying around like they’ve got survival instincts.

They’re still dumb. But in a good way.

[h2][b]The Closer[/b][/h2]
Release is near.
Real near.
[b]Midgets, get your wallets ready.[/b]

— Toxic Developer
